mark1.tip: 1 Mark: your rolling average combined damage (last ~100 battles) must beat 65% of players on this tank over the last 14 days

mark2.tip: 2 Marks: your rolling average combined damage (last ~100 battles) must beat 85% of players on this tank over the last 14 days

mark3.tip: 3 Marks: your rolling average combined damage (last ~100 battles) must beat 95% of players on this tank over the last 14 days
